pages.title: A stranger asks for help · 1/3
paragraphs: Evan was new in Chicago. He had a map on his phone, but the battery was dead. He needed the bank, so he asked a woman on the corner, “**Excuse me, where is the bank?**”
She smiled. “**It’s on Main Street**,” she said. “Is it far?” Evan asked. “**No, it’s five minutes on foot**,” she answered. “You can walk there.”
pages.prompt: Onde começa e o que acontece?

pages.title: A stranger asks for help · 2/3
paragraphs: Evan looked at the street. There was a pharmacy on the left and a small café on the right. “Is it next to the post office?” he asked. “**Yes, it’s next to it**,” she said. “The post office has a big blue sign.”
“**Thank you so much!**” Evan said. “**You’re welcome. Have a nice day!**” she said. “**Good luck! It’s easy to find**.” Evan felt happy. People in this city were friendly.

pages.title: A stranger asks for help · 3/3
paragraphs: He walked past the café, past the pharmacy and saw the blue sign. Next to it was the bank, a tall gray building. It was open, and the door was heavy.
Inside, a man at the desk said, “Good morning. How can I help you?” Evan took a deep breath and began to speak slowly, in clear English.
